summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. III, a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq SPAC (units AACIU, shares AACI, warrants AACIW), filed an 8-K on October 31, 2026 disclosing a Business Combination Agreement with British Columbia-based Brains Bioceutical Corp. and newly formed PubCo, executing a de-SPAC transaction. The structure uses a Cayman Merger Sub and a Canadian Merger Sub, with a pre-closing Class B-to-Class A conversion and reverse amalgamation into PubCo. The filing excerpt omits price per share, implied equity value, premium, and outside dates; no advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch redemption levels, PIPE financing and closing conditions.
